module.title: Quantitative Foundations I — Numeracy & Algebra
module.destination: From a Class-10-ish starting point, become reliable with exact numerical reasoning, ratios/percentages/units, estimation, symbolic algebra, equations, inequalities, absolute value and elementary quadratics—without hidden calculator dependence.
module.gate: M01 is not cleared by page completion. Clearance requires independent evidence across the session ownership claims plus delayed transfer/synthesis evidence. The dedicated course page records study evidence; it does not silently rewrite legacy T22 progress.
module.nextBoundary: M02 owns functions, domains/ranges, graphs, coordinate geometry, parameters, transformations, exponentials/logarithms, sequences, sigma notation and essential trigonometry. M01 must not pre-teach those as the main capability.
